note: Human-control sources (plan.md section 5). human.py refuses to ingest a source until license_status is "confirmed", which is set by a person after reading the source's actual terms; record what was read and when in license_checked.

persuade.name: PERSUADE 2.0 corpus
persuade.url: to confirm (1.0 is https://github.com/scrosseye/PERSUADE_corpus, which points to a separate 2.0 page; paper: https://zenodo.org/records/8221504)
persuade.collected: before 2022 per the corpus paper (to confirm)
persuade.provenance_method: collected by researchers from schools under documented conditions before generative AI was widely available; not verified per author
persuade.license: unconfirmed (PERSUADE 1.0 data: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the Zenodo CC BY 4.0 covers the preprint only)
persuade.permitted_use: to confirm: non-commercial research; whether submitting essays to external detectors is allowed

ellipse.name: ELLIPSE corpus (English language learners)
ellipse.url: to confirm (paper: https://zenodo.org/records/11217937; first released through Kaggle's Feedback Prize ELL competition)
ellipse.provenance_method: standardized test conditions, collected by researchers; not verified per author
ellipse.license: unconfirmed (Zenodo CC BY 4.0 covers the preprint only)

micusp.name: Michigan Corpus of Upper-level Student Papers
micusp.provenance_method: submitted by students to the corpus project with consent; unsupervised writing
micusp.license: free for research and teaching, non-commercial; (c) Regents of the University of Michigan
micusp.permitted_use: to confirm whether submitting text to external detectors counts as permitted use
micusp.exclude_students: every student id used by data/human_corpus or data/sealed_test (editor sealed test)
